In chapter 139 part 2, she strains her telepathy past its limit to hunt down Donovan Desmond's thoughts, and it works, she locks onto him from farther away than ever before. It costs her a nosebleed and a scolding from Yor. She's doing this as someone Project Apple once experimented on, the same program that made her a test subject before the Forgers. This manga just crossed forty-two million copies, still building toward its endgame. Is Anya getting closer to Donovan, or closer to the past that shaped her? Leave your take.

packages.vo: Kaiju Number 8 is coming back, but not with Kafka. The new trailer confirms Narumi's Week at Work, a four-episode short premiering September 5th, and this time the spotlight is on Gen Narumi, the captain everyone calls Japan's strongest anti-kaiju combatant. Off the battlefield he is lazy, obsessed with video games, and constantly late. On it, he predicts every enemy move before it happens. This short finally answers what his actual week looks like between fights. Production I.G is animating all four episodes, dropping weekly through September 26th on Crunchyroll. Is Narumi's downtime going to be funnier than his fights? Leave your take.
